title: Africa Speaks, America Answers
artist: Guy Warren with the Gene Esposito Band

drum_performances.name: Guy Warren
drum_performances.why_it_matters: His first album, made in Chicago: Afro-jazz on record, with "That Happy Feeling".

drums.description: Warren's hand-drummed Ghanaian talking-drum and conga figures under an American big-band arrangement: African drumming answering jazz, the album's idea.
The title piece sets West African hand-drum patterns against Gene Esposito's swing rhythm section, an early meeting of Ghanaian drumming and jazz.
